xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4254: Conversations: accept all five effort levels, set effort at creation, keep it on switch-model, and add --effort to pan handoff/fork

plan.title: Conversations: accept all five effort levels, set effort at creation, keep it on switch-model, and add --effort to pan handoff/fork
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The two-segment subsystem rule counts each doc file (configuration/effort.mdx, features/conversations.mdx, docs/FORKS.md), scripts/lint-effort.sh and sync-sources/skills as separate subsystems; the code itself spans src/lib/overdeck, src/cli and src/dashboard/frontend. This is already one of eight sibling slices of PAN-4249, and splitting further would separate the CLI --effort flag from the server parameter it forwards and the create-payload picker from the create endpoint that stores it. Files_scope also lists two checkpoint-only fallback files (conversations-supervisor.test.ts, NewConversationPickers.tsx).

narratives.Problem: SAFE_EFFORT_PATTERN (/^(low|medium|high)$/) in conversation-runtime.ts rejects xhigh/max at create and spawn while the thinking-level API persists them (and pi's off/minimal), so a conversation changed live to xhigh throws 'Invalid effort level' on resume and restart-all. The dashboard never sends effort on creation, resume does not persist a body effort, switch-model ignores effort, pan handoff/fork cannot set it, launch paths use ad hoc `?? 'high'` fallbacks with no clamping, and the frontend keeps private copies of the effort enum.
narratives.Proposal: Add src/lib/overdeck/conversation-effort.ts (validate, canonicalize pi off/minimal to low, resolve via resolveEffort with the opencode free-form carve-out). spawnConversationSession, create, resume, switch-model and the summary-fork endpoint use it and persist the clamped level; the thinking-level API uses isEffortLevel and stores off/minimal as low. pan handoff/pan fork gain --effort (default inherits the parent). The Home composer and Command Deck sidebar get an effort picker sent in the create payload. EffortPicker/ModelPicker derive lists from the contracts EFFORT_LEVELS, resolveComposerEffort maps off/minimal to low, lint:effort baselines drop, and effort.mdx/conversations.mdx/FORKS.md describe the new behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to lanes: src/lib/lanes/launch.ts keeps SAFE_EFFORT_PATTERN and still refuses xhigh/max (PAN-4223 D20)
- No live effort change for claude-code conversations and no change to the 'Effort unverified' chip (PAN-4255)
- No effort persistence on AgentState or agent relaunch paths (PAN-4253)
- No change to Flywheel's spawnConversationSession(..., 'high', ...) call or other role launch surfaces (PAN-4256)
- No effort display in conversation headers, pan status/show or cost data beyond the Effort line pan handoff/fork print (PAN-4259)
- No removal of harness-adapter fallbacks outside conversation-runtime.ts, e.g. launcher-generator.ts piEffort/museEffort ?? 'high' (PAN-4260)
- No attempt to launch pi with --thinking off/minimal
- No CLI-side validation of --effort values (the server validates)
- No xhigh or max default anywhere and no edit to sync-sources/rules/effort-high-default.md
- No raise of any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: Lanes stay out of scope; SAFE_EFFORT_PATTERN stays exported for the lane door only
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue never names lanes, launch.test.ts asserts the lane door refuses xhigh, and including lanes adds four files and a subsystem; lint:effort keeps conversation-runtime.ts at baseline 1 for that line.

autoDecisions.summary: pi off/minimal are persisted as low; the live pi runtime still receives off/minimal
autoDecisions.rationale: Nothing verifies omp --thinking off at launch and the ohmypi harness declares effortLevels low..xhigh; canonical storage removes the resume crash at the cost of relaunching off as low.

autoDecisions.summary: Persist the clamped level (stored value = launched value) on create, resume, switch-model and fork
autoDecisions.rationale: A row must never claim a level the model cannot run; it keeps PAN-4255's verification display honest.

autoDecisions.summary: Conversation launches pass issueId to resolveEffort so the project layer applies; no role/tier/plan layers
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4249 requires every launch path to call resolveEffort; conversations are not role launches but issue-scoped ones belong to a project.

autoDecisions.summary: opencode keeps its free-form effort variant carve-out
autoDecisions.rationale: resolveEffort throws on non-canonical input while opencode legitimately accepts named variants.

autoDecisions.summary: Absent effort is stored as NULL on create and fork
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches today's schema semantics; the launch still resolves the default high or the project layer.

autoDecisions.summary: Switch-model clamps the stored effort and does not accept a new effort; an effort invalid for the new harness resets to NULL
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks only that switch-model keep effort clamped; resetting avoids a later launch throw.

autoDecisions.summary: Fork precedence is request effort, then parent effort (when valid for the successor harness), then NULL
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue: 'The default inherits the parent's effort'; dropping an incompatible parent value avoids failing the fork.

autoDecisions.summary: The CLI forwards --effort without validating it
autoDecisions.rationale: The server is the single validator and opencode variants must keep working; a 400 already surfaces as ForkServerError exit 1.

autoDecisions.summary: Clean ModelPicker.tsx enum copies here although lint:effort tags that row PAN-4259
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body explicitly assigns the EffortPicker/ModelPicker enum replacement to this slice.

autoDecisions.summary: New-conversation pickers default to the browser-stored composer effort (loadStoredEffort, default high) and omit effort when the model has no effort levels
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the existing picker storage key and keeps the high default rule.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue's simple/TalkItThrough.tsx reference is retargeted to home/HomeComposer.tsx
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4280 turned TalkItThrough.tsx into a re-export shim; the create payload now lives in HomeComposer.tsx.

items.title: Add conversation-effort.ts with validate, canonicalize and resolve helpers

expected_outputs: lint:effort exits 0 and does not list conversation-effort.ts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Create src/lib/overdeck/conversation-effort.ts exactly as the PRD snippet: canonicalConversationEffort (off/minimal -> low), isValidConversationEffort(value, harness) (five canonical levels, pi off/minimal, opencode free-form /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/ only on opencode), resolveConversationEffort({effort, model, harness, issueId}) which passes an opencode variant through and otherwise returns resolveEffort({explicit: canonical value or undefined, issueId, model, harness}).effort. Add the helper unit tests to the new file src/lib/overdeck/__tests__/conversation-effort.test.ts (table in PRD WI-2 'resolveConversationEffort table' and 'isValidConversationEffort'). No lint:effort pattern may appear in the new module.

resolveConversationEffort returns 'low' for 'off' and 'minimal', and defaults to 'high' when effort is undefined and no issueId is given
resolveConversationEffort rejects 'bogus' on claude-code by throwing InvalidEffortError, and returns 'bogus-variant' unchanged on opencode
isValidConversationEffort returns true for the five levels and off/minimal on claude-code, false for 'bogus' on claude-code, and true for 'custom' on opencode
